description: Fetch the FULL text and a formal citation of one Romanian court decision by its number (e.g. "170/2019"). Turns a jurisprudence search hit — which carries only a bare number — into a citable decision: 'Instituție, Tip nr. N/AAAA din DATA'. Pass `court` and/or `year` to disambiguate. Use after search_semantic/search_lexical with sources=["jurisprudence"] finds a relevant decision you want to quote in full. Pass `section` to avoid pulling 30 pages: "dispozitiv" for the operative ruling, "considerente" for the reasoning, or a keyword (returns the dispozitiv + only the considerente that mention it).

year.description: Optional year to disambiguate, as a string: "2019".

name: lookup_decision
